mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is not negative (Pearson correlation > -0.1) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7.0%, it signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors flee to safety.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an imminent monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 233.5 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a strong housing market (HOUST > 840.0) signals continued economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 840.0 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 234.0, it signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 234.0.

mechanism_narrative: A strong manufacturing sector (INDPRO > 99.0) and strong labor market (PAYEMS > 136000.0) signal robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 99.0 AND PAYEMS > 136000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 830.0, it signals a potential slowdown in the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 830.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 99.0), a decline in manufacturing output signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 99.0 and the economy is in a manufacturing slowdown.
